analysis:
The supplied units are BASE-side excerpts (lines 3591-4070) of docs/architecture/inference.md. The only visible head changes are documentation: a date bump at line 3, KV re-slice floor wording near 985-989, a new cluster service health-file paragraph at head 3532-3540, and edits at head 5234-5288 and later. The patch is truncated, and the 5200+ ranges are outside the supplied base units, so those edits are not reviewed here. No code, configuration or control changes are visible in these units.

The health-file paragraph describes DARKBLOOM_CLUSTER_MEMBER_HEALTH_FILE, a supervisor liveness guard that accepts only a beat with the service's own PID, and a separate part-health.json. This touches availability and supervisor integrity (TB-003/T-043 style concerns). It is documentation only, and the implementing source is not supplied, so I cannot verify the PID check or file ownership. The re-slice floor change is a KV memory admission behavior claim (T-016/T-029 availability territory), also unverified in code.

The base excerpt describes tensor-parallel/GLM cluster internals: sealed AES-GCM all-sums, SSD prefix cache partitions, owner-only files under ~/.darkbloom/cluster, and an environment allowlist for ranks. These were unchanged context. The prefix-cache statements (tenant partitions, encrypted SSD tier) are consistent with T-041 and add no new at-rest surface. No finding is warranted from this evidence. Integration should check that the source commits implementing the health-file and KV floor changes match the documented controls, and examine the truncated later hunks of the patch.
